profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Dell Technologies
profile.summary:
Energetic software engineer with 8+ years experience developing robust code for high-volume businesses. 
Thorough hands-on experience in all levels of software life-cycle, including planning, analysis,development, testing, bug fixing and software maintenance. 
Supportive and enthusiastic team player with deep creative thinker, dedicated to streamlining process and efficiently resolving project issues. 
Willing to take ownership of core components.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
I am working with Dell Data Guardian Web Application team. In initial days, I work with EDG team and design product wire frame using axure.

Working as a Security Champion and handling SDLC Security every release.

Involved in requirement gathering, analysis, design and development phase.

Hosted spring MVC REST application on tomcat server. Design and develop angular client application to communicate with hosted REST api using angular resource and promise.

Designed, architected and developed Cloud Aggregator application using OAuth2 three legged mechanism with command design pattern and integrate it in policy driven web application.

Designed and developed all kind of file operation functionality such as file rename, file delete, file upload, file download and file viewer with our patented encryption decryption technology.

Developed external user authentication using aws cognito and internal user authentication with Azure AD using OAuth2 and openID mechanism.

Worked on SaaS multi tenant aws hosted Dell Data Guardian web application. Deploying web application using Ansible and docker. Worked on various services such as Cloud watch logs to separate out functional and dev ops logs for different tenant, api gateway to create rest api for micro service, s3 where I hosted configuration files for app use.

Worked on Collabora Editor/Viewer to view and edit encrypted documents based upon user and enterprise policy.

Having exposure with various front-end, back-end, devops related technologies such as KendoUI, Bootstrap, Angularjs, Lodash, Jquery, Spring , Spring-AOP, Spring-MVC, maven, Hibernate, Python, Docker, Ansible, Redis, Mongodb etc.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Having opportunities on working in Home Loan Applications such as SOFI(SOLUTIONS FINDER), Loan App, DGW(DIRECT GATE WAY, middle tier Legacy application of ING DIRECT), SASSY and highly appreciated eAPI project(REST API ).

Extensively worked as a Core developer on PreQual Loan Application project. Created 6 brand new REST Api service (Monthly payment calculator, Affordability Calculator, Refinance Calculator, Applicants and Applications).

I had a chance to work on several technology such as Spring MVC, Spring Web flow 2.0, Spring AOP, Spring OXM, Oracle Jrockit, JSR 303, Bean validation 1.1, Jquery, angularjs, Node.js.

I tested my code using several industry best tools such as TestNG, Junit, mockito, soapui, firbug, sonarqube etc. I also took part in code review, grooming, deployment, triage meetings.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I worked as a Front-end and Back-End engineer. I created 6 JSP pages out of 40 pages. Used JSP, JSTL, Struts2, taglib to create appealing looking pages.

Used Hibernate as a ORM to persist user information. Developed service model for the various section of the application. Used IBM RAD IDE for rapid web development and web sphere to deploy the application.

Involved in requirement gathering with Business Analyst.

Hosted several Java Community of Practice session to learn and teach new technology within team.

Introduced Micado Method to the team for rapid decomposition and compose application.

Involved in UI and performance testing of the application.

Worked in Water fall methodology.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
The project involves in development of HMS Application for the hospitality businesses. HMS version 3.5 (Hospitality Management Solution) project is designed for the user to do reservation for the Guest across glob and local.

This application has several modules like Employee Management, House Keeping Management, Guest Management, Group Management, Agent and Organization Management, A/R Account Management and Revenue Management. This application serves the full functionality to the user in hospitality businesses.

I worked on j2EE 1.4, Struts 2, Hibernate, Oracle 11g, SQL Server 2008, NGPMS Text System, JavaScript, JSP, JSTL, Servlets, CSS, HTML, DHTML,JIRA 5.2, Tortoise SVN 1.6.12

honors.title: Bronze Award
honors.description: Implementing critical feature for external user using AWS Cognito. Helping other team members in their Email Encryption task.  Helping new team members to setup their environment

honors.title: Bronze Award
honors.description: Completing task on time help team to meet goal goal for DG web 1.0. Helping QA and automation team to identify severe and critical bugs
